subject: Annual evaluation playbook: exception routing & manager scripts (drafts)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Diane Harper <diane@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Annual evaluation playbook: initial draft + exception routing for sensitive roles

Hi all,

Attaching the first consolidated playbook for this year's performance cycle and two supporting files: a manager script (manager_script_v0.3.docx) and a CSV with the small set of roles we'd like to route through a special, confidential path (confidential_sensitive_roles.csv). There's also a quick Gantt export of the week-by-week comms/timeline (timeline_weekly_gantt.png).

High-level ask: please review and flag any objections or required changes by EOD Monday so I can lock the manager script and the routing table. Specific areas to check: 
- Exception routing: we've proposed a three-tier path for sensitive roles (silent notification to manager, HR-only doc access, legal approval required). Confirm if that aligns with your expectations.
- Manager script: short, scripted language for 1:1s + escalation wording. Keep it tight — it's going to be used by dozens of managers.
- Timeline: does the proposed two-week manager calibration window create any product/eng infra conflicts?

Diane, thank you for the redline pass you offered — any early notes welcome.

Next steps I'm proposing (if we get alignment):
1) Lock scripts + exception list (Mar 9)
2) Manager calibration sessions (Mar 16–23)
3) Org-wide comms go-live (Apr 1, manager-first rollout)

Attachments: manager_script_v0.3.docx (docx), confidential_sensitive_roles.csv (csv), timeline_weekly_gantt.png (image)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
People Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Annual evaluation playbook: initial draft + exception routing for sensitive roles

Soojin — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes:

- Timeline: I prefer the manager calibration start on Mar 18 (gives teams a week after the holiday to breathe). Can we shift the Gantt by one week and still hit Apr 1 for org comms?
- Manager script: looks good; I'll add two short bullets on handling compensation-related queries (don't discuss specific numbers; escalate to People Ops).
- Confidential list: please flag the two roles in legal/security we discussed — those should be routed to Legal first.

I'll take the manager script doc and add my bullets directly; happy to sync live for 20 minutes tomorrow if helpful.

Laura Bennett
VP, People
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Soojin. A few legal points from my side:

- Please add a mandatory legal sign-off step for any role that appears on the confidential list before manager communication. I've sketched a one-page "legal_approval_checklist.pdf" to attach to the workflow; that should be completed by the Legal owner.
- For EU-based employees on the confidential list we will need localized comms and possibly translations; recommend budgeting for vendor translation — I'll loop procurement if we decide to proceed.
- Please don't circulate the full CSV beyond People Ops + Legal + the direct manager. Put a persistent access control on the Drive folder.

I'll add inline comments in the playbook and in the confidential CSV.

Soojin — thanks for sharing. I reviewed the manager script and the exception flow. High-level redlines attached (diane_redlines.docx). A couple of immediate recommendations: 

- Silent-mode approach: for the 12 roles you flagged, I recommend a 48-hour hold before any calendar invites to broaden investigator responsibilities and privacy checks.
- Manager script: tighten the first two opening lines to reduce framing bias (I've suggested alternate language).
- Calibration: run one live calibration session with cross-functional managers (Legal + Eng + Product) rather than purely People Ops-led; that reduces ambiguity in sensitive cases.

I'm available Mon/Tue to run the calibration session.

Best,
Diane Harper
Founder, PeopleOps Consulting

Subject: Final: playbook decisions + next steps (calibration schedule locked)

Team — thanks for the quick reviews and comments. Summary of agreed decisions and owners: 

- Timeline: manager calibration will run Mar 18–25 (shifted one week per Laura) and org comms will proceed Apr 1. Owner: Soojin (finalize scripts by Mar 12).
- Exception routing: confirmed three-tier process. Legal sign-off required for any role on the confidential list. Owner: Markus (legal_approval_checklist.pdf).
- Access controls: confidential CSV will be restricted to People Ops + Legal + direct manager. Owner: IT (access policy request submitted).
- Calibration sessions: People Ops + Legal + 6 cross-functional managers; Diane to run two live sessions (Diane available Mon/Tue).

Immediate asks: 
1) Laura — please paste your compensation-handling bullets into manager_script_v0.3.docx and send back by Mar 10.
2) Markus — please finalize the legal checklist and mark any additional roles that need routing by Mar 11.
3) IT lead (cc'd offline) — apply access controls to the Drive folder and confirm by Mar 10.

I'll circulate a short manager-facing comms script (one page) once the edits land. Thanks everyone for the fast turn.

Soojin Lee
People Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
